start.title: Crows Over the Ravine
start.text: A knot of black crows circles below the road where the land falls away into a narrow ravine. Something red catches between the trees at the bottom.

buckets.flavourText: You find an old animal track zig-zagging through the rocks.
The obvious descent is steeper than it first looked.

steep.title: Loose Stone
steep.text: The slope breaks under every second step. A direct descent is possible, but one slip would carry you to the bottom faster than you intend.

buckets.flavourText: You lower yourself from root to root and reach the ravine floor without incident.
You slide the last few metres and arrive bruised but upright.
A foothold tears loose. You stop the fall only by catching a root with both hands.

bottom.title: The Red Scarf
bottom.text: The crows are feeding on a dead mule, not a person. A bright red scarf is tied around its harness, and beneath the saddlebag you find a courier tube stamped with the hub seal. The wax cap is intact.

choices.text: Take the sealed tube back unopened

sealed.title: A Courier's Work Unfinished
sealed.text: You leave the wax untouched. Whatever is inside has already survived a ravine and the crows; it can survive the walk back.

open_tube.title: Routine Orders
open_tube.text: Inside is no conspiracy—just a patrol rota, a requisition for lamp oil, and a complaint about missing winter boots. Somehow the ordinary nature of it makes the dead mule feel sadder.

turn_back.title: Not Worth a Broken Neck
turn_back.text: You climb back to the road. The crows settle again as soon as you are gone.

leave.title: Black Wings
leave.text: You continue on. The circling birds remain visible for a long time against the white ravine.
